name: H-E-B Manufacturing - Houston Milk & Bread Plant - Houston TX

fieldNotes.location: Roster GEOMETRIC_CENTER coordinate (29.843857, -95.537401) is roughly the campus center. The milk & bread plant complex was identified as the two large manufacturing buildings immediately E of the snack plant on the H-E-B Windfern campus. The bakery building is confirmed by 'BAKE...' branded trailers backed into its W dock face. All H-E-B Windfern facilities (RSC, milk plant, bread plant) share address 4625 Windfern Rd, Houston TX 77041.
fieldNotes.buildingIdentification: Two distinct manufacturing buildings audited - the eastern building (bakery, confirmed by branded trailers) and the western building (milk plant, with a process annex). Exact milk-vs-bread assignment and door counts are estimates - medium confidence.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The plant complex sits within the large fenced H-E-B Windfern campus. No barrier arm, sliding gate or guard booth was positively identified at the complex's access or the campus entrances probed - access is via open campus internal roads. Classified false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth identified at the complex or campus entrances probed.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: The milk & bread plant is part of a large multi-building H-E-B campus that also contains the Windfern RSC and (just NW) the snack plant.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two separate manufacturing buildings (milk plant, bread plant) with distinct dock banks on different building faces.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Extensive trailer drop yards flank both buildings - a large drop yard on the W and additional trailer parking E.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Trailers backed into dock banks on multiple faces of both buildings; estimated ~35 total - 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line with a siding runs along the south edge of the milk & bread plant complex, serving the campus.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense NW Houston industrial/suburban fabric - Urban.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~22 acres for the milk & bread plant complex and immediate yards within the larger campus.
